# BeCreative Skill for Muse

Research-grounded divergent ideation (Verbalized Sampling plus extended thinking, cited at roughly 1.6–2.1x diversity gains): it generates five deliberately improbable internal candidates, then surfaces the best one — with seven workflows including standard and maximum creativity modes, brainstorming, tree-of-thoughts, technical creativity, and test-corpus expansion. Use cases: naming a product, article angles, genuinely original solutions. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it was written for the LifeOS ecosystem, so its voice notification (localhost:31337) and run-journal features won't work outside LifeOS — but the core ideation technique works fine as plain copy-paste, no LifeOS required. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
